response.text: {"title":"November starters: onboarding and laptop","query":{"from":[{"capability":"Onboarding","sheet":"Plans"},{"capability":"Onboarding","sheet":"Tasks"},{"capability":"Spend","sheet":"Purchases"}],"join":[{"source":"Tasks","kind":"link","left":"Tasks.Plan","right":null},{"source":"Purchases","kind":"names","left":"Purchases.What","right":"Plans.Name"}],"where":"{\"op\":\"and\",\"args\":[{\"op\":\"between\",\"args\":[{\"col\":\"Plans.Start date\"},\"2026-11-01\",\"2026-11-30\"]}]}","group_by":[{"column":"Plans.Name","by":"value"},{"column":"Plans.Start date","by":"value"}],"measures":[{"fn":"count","source":"Tasks","column":null,"where":null,"as":"Tasks","hidden":true},{"fn":"count","source":"Tasks","column":null,"where":"{\"op\":\"eq\",\"args\":[{\"col\":\"Tasks.Status\"},\"Done\"]}","as":"Done","hidden":true},{"fn":"first","source":"Purchases","column":"Purchases.Status","where":null,"as":"Laptop order","hidden":true}],"computed":[{"as":"Onboarding","expr":null,"template":"{Done} of {Tasks} tasks done","empty":"No tasks yet","format":"text"},{"as":"Laptop","expr":null,"template":"{Laptop order}","empty":"No laptop ordered","format":"text"}],"order_by":[{"column":"Plans.Start date","dir":"asc"}],"limit":null},"chart":{"kind":"none","series":[]},"how":["Who: people with an onboarding plan starting Nov 1–30, 2026, with their start date.","Onboarding: tasks in their plan that are Done, out of all their tasks.","Laptop: the status of the purchase in Spend whose description names the person, such as Ordered or Received."],"missing":null}
